calibration_and_evaluation_separation.calibration: A threshold requires a cited acceptance objective and evidence source; reuse of validation data must be disclosed.
calibration_and_evaluation_separation.candidate_evaluation: Evaluate candidates against a fixed, versioned threshold without recalibrating it on the candidate evaluation observations.
calibration_and_evaluation_separation.independent_confirmation: Use a distinct, pre-specified evaluation cohort for independent confirmation; this project validation evidence is selection-conditioned.
calibration_and_evaluation_separation.test_data: Test-set evidence is excluded from calibration and acceptance-policy definition.

autoencoder.rationale: No documented business or technical acceptance requirement or independent validation evidence supports a numeric cutoff. The available validation observations were used for model or checkpoint selection and cannot provide independent confirmation of a cutoff calibrated on those same observations.
